integrity: The formulas are obtained directly from exact without-replacement probabilities for two-position, three-position, and four-position patterns. The nonzero disjoint result uses a finite divisibility argument, and the total variance identity is checked algebraically. Exact exhaustive enumeration is supplementary rather than a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is pairwise and second-order; it does not determine the full joint law of all transition indicators.
The main two-distance formula is for a binary alphabet under uniform random ordering conditional on fixed category counts.
Classical runs monographs may contain the raw pairwise covariance identities under another notation; the principal novelty claim is the complete sign and independence phase classification.
title: Exact dependence phases of fixed-composition run transitions
